nodes.label: Onboarding kickoff meeting (step 3) on AAA001 calendar
nodes.norm_label: onboarding kickoff meeting (step 3) on aaa001 calendar
nodes.rationale: Uses AAA001's existing GHL connection so no new key is needed; if unavailable the step shows support WhatsApp instead of disappearing. Slots cached 1 min; page doesn't wait if GHL > 2.5s.

nodes.label: Per-workspace integrations encrypted AES-256-GCM
nodes.rationale: Keys stored encrypted in DB per company, never as global env vars.

nodes.label: Deploy a Vercel workflow
nodes.rationale: Vercel Hobby Git integration only accepts commits from the project owner account; deploying via CLI with the owner's token avoids author checks across multiple Vercel accounts (one per client).

nodes.label: VERCEL_TOKEN / VERCEL_ORG_ID / VERCEL_PROJECT_ID secrets
nodes.rationale: Without the secrets the workflow warns and exits instead of failing.

nodes.label: Vercel daily crons (flows, deliver, ghl-sync)
nodes.rationale: Hobby plan rejects deploys with crons more frequent than daily; this silently froze production for several commits. Real cadence needs Vercel Pro or an external scheduler (cron-job.org, QStash).
